prompt:
Animate this lineup of ten game enemies as ONE death animation, all ten at the same time, each dying in place. The camera is fixed and does not move, zoom or pan. Left and right in this description are the screen's left and right. Every character starts facing screen right, and its killing blow comes from an unseen attacker standing just outside the picture to the right.
Every beat, for each character: it stays exactly where it stands in the image, inside its own cell, and never slides, is thrown or flies back; it never moves into another character's space and the ten never touch or overlap; each character's body ends up inside the empty magenta space around its own starting position, never nearer than half a body length to another character; every character keeps its own size, the small ones stay small and the large ones stay large.
The death is one continuous move and the same for every character: the blow lands and the head jerks back toward screen left, the weapon loosens, the legs buckle and the body sinks straight down over its own feet, then falls backward toward screen left right where it stood and ends lying flat on the ground, head toward screen left, limbs limp, the weapon lying on the ground beside the body. The Frost Wolf ends lying on its side because of its four legs. Every character keeps its own weapon: the axe with the Frostbite Raider, the curved ice sword with the Icicle Stalker, the bow with the Rime Archer, the javelin with the Spear Hurler, the crystal staff with the Snow Witch, the bone totem with the Blizzard Shaman, the broad sword with the Frost Knight, the giant maul with the Glacier Gladiator, the greatsword with the Frost Warlord.
After the fall the move ends and the final pose is held: no getting up, no second movement, no return to the starting stance. Every character keeps its own design, colours and outline exactly as in the image; the crystals and the glow stay on its own body; no motion trail and no shattering ice is drawn; no character has a tail except the Frost Wolf.
The flat solid pure magenta background stays unchanged and fixed in every frame: no scenery, no ground, no shadows, no extra effects, no blood, no text, no grid, no camera shake.
